headline: UnrealIRCd flaw exploited (KEV due 11-16); Cursor breach led to malicious Claude Code extension; SCKit still top story

bullets.text: New: The Hacker News reports attackers exploiting the UnrealIRCd flaw that enables server-level command injection. CISA added it to KEV as CVE-2026-114713 on 11-13 with a federal due date of 11-16.
New: Cursor confirms a security breach led to a malicious Claude Code extension (BleepingComputer). The board carries no further detail on affected versions or a clean release yet.
SCKit remains the top story at 9 outlets: worm-like malware aimed at MSPs that abuses ScreenConnect to deploy remote access and target technician sessions. Microsoft has published details.

Check Point CVE-2026-123039 (PHP2Shell, 5 outlets) is on KEV, due 11-16: attackers gain root, plant a TSGA backdoor and wipe VMware ESXi. The N-central zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC, including servers on Hotfix 2.

Breaches and crime: Uber driver license data stolen via Fireworks AI (4 outlets); US disrupts North Korean campaign behind $400M crypto theft; City of Osaka (1 million people), TSMC, 144,000+ Norwegian and Widerøe passengers, UT Arlington.

Still active: Apache httpd CVE-2026-119618 and the SignDrop Windows SYSTEM zero-day. KEV due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Openwave CVE-2026-111793, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. Last 7 days run 1.19x the 90-day average.

actions: UnrealIRCd: patch or take internet-facing servers offline for CVE-2026-114713 before the 11-16 KEV due date, and check them for injected commands.
Cursor and Claude Code users: review installed extensions against Cursor's disclosure and remove any you cannot verify.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, review technician sessions and hunt for SCKit using Microsoft's guidance.
Check Point: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-123039 before 11-16, restrict management access, hunt for TSGA backdoors, keep ESXi backups offline.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
Patch Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618 and queue BroadWorks, Openwave, Outlook and Chromium before 11-24.
